# Mounted inventory sale recovery

Synthetic scheduled checkout with a lost response, USD 12.50 captured price, frozen product/unit/warehouse labels, UTC quote time and America/Los_Angeles period timezone. No customer data or live request.

The images render the complete mounted InventoryCheckoutPage recovery flow (header, persistent frozen details and footer actions), at 320/768px width, 900px height and 1.5x text. The fixture loads NotoSans for NotoSans/Geist/Roboto and MaterialIcons explicitly; they are widget evidence, not native font or OS persistence acceptance. Tests verify metadata Retry is absent and receipt recovery remains enabled without current catalog metadata. Actual pixels inspected.

Source fixture: apps/mobile/test/features/inventory/season_pricing/season_pricing_checkout_test.dart.
